case.title: Google Calendar sync stopped
case.subject: Appointments not showing in Google Calendar anymore
case.text:
Hello,

Since last week new Slotwise appointments don't show up in my Google Calendar. It used to work fine. I changed my Google password recently if that matters. My colleague's sync still works.

Daniel
case.why: Classic sync issue after a password change; the KB says disconnect and reconnect.

output.reply:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for the details. The password change is very likely the cause: Google sometimes revokes access after a password change, which stops appointments from appearing in your calendar.

To fix it, please reconnect:
1. Go to Profile → Calendar sync.
2. Click Disconnect.
3. Click Connect Google Calendar and sign in with the Google account that owns the calendar.
4. Allow both permissions (view and edit events), otherwise sync will only work in one direction.
5. Choose which calendars should block availability.

Changes usually appear within 5 minutes.

If sync still fails after reconnecting, reply with your name and an example appointment that didn't sync, and our team can check the sync log.

Slotwise Support
